text: Oh, hello! New face. I like new faces. Brett. I sell knives, and I walk this whole town twice a day selling them.
Here, you look like you could use one. Go on, take it. Nobody on Brinehollow should walk about without a blade, and this one's on me.

menu.text: What can I do for you, friend?

shop.text: Daggers, dirks, the odd stiletto. All sharp, all honest. Have a look.

text: Here's one Hesk won't tell you, because he thinks of it as his: the fish bite best when the light's changing. Dawn and dusk.
And keep a knife on you when you fish. Cut your own bait from a crab or a bit of fish on the action wheel and you'll never come home empty-handed.
Thank you! Same pair for eleven years. Up and down that stair, across every plank on this island, and they've never once let the sea in.
A good pair of boots will last you a long time, friend. Spend on your boots and your blade. Everything else is just weather.

bye.text: You too! I'll be about. I'm always about.
